reason: My electrician is back in three weeks and I need fixtures in hand well before that. 10 to 12 business days is cutting it close, made-to-order at 6 weeks is out, and I have never heard of this store.
objection: Nothing says it is UL listed, so I do not know it is safe or that my electrician will install it, and with a hard install date I cannot risk a slow delivery or a return that I pay to ship back.
would_change_my_mind: A visible UL/ETL listing on the product page, a guaranteed in-stock ship date that lands well inside two weeks, and free return shipping if the fixture does not work for the install.
